# TuneLab

> Prompt-driven fine-tuning platform for small language models. Describe your task in natural language and TuneLab generates training data, tunes a compact SLM, and evaluates it automatically.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the TuneLab platform, features, use cases, and pricing.
